facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹9,554 cr, +24% on the prior twelve months.

Revenue has compounded at 26% over 10 years, 25% over 5 and 2% over 3; the last twelve months (+24%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (34% vs 2%): operating leverage is working.
Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +20% → +18% → +28% → +28% YoY.
Operating margin has expanded to 10.1% from 6.8% a year ago (+3.3 pp).
Annual operating margin has ranged from −48% to 6% over five years; the latest year (6%) sits at the top of that range.
Borrowings are ₹256 cr against equity of ₹16,604 cr: debt/equity 0.02× (was 0.02× in Mar 2023).

Other income is 80% of pre-tax profit over the last twelve months — earnings lean on non-operating items.

business.what: Paytm operates an AI-powered omni-channel payment platform for consumers and merchants. It generates revenue through payment processing, device subscriptions, distribution of financial services (loans, insurance, wealth management), and marketing services including advertising and ticketing.

segments.note: Includes payment processing and device subscription revenue.

segments.name: Distribution of Financial Services
segments.note: Fastest-growing segment involving loan, insurance, and wealth distribution.

segments.note: Includes advertising, travel ticketing, and deals.

guidance.label: Payment processing margin improvement
guidance.statement: Management expects a 2.5 bps improvement on payment processing margin over a period of two to three quarters.
guidance.quote: 2.5 bps improvement on payment processing margin, let's say, over a period of two to three quarters.
guidance.speaker: Vijay Shekhar Sharma

verdict.detail: Not checkable against headline financials; kept as a watch item.

guidance.label: Device rollout capex
guidance.statement: Management expects device rollout capex to be around 400 crores.
guidance.quote: it was about 400 crores on a kind of inward devices count basis, and we expect that to be the same.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: FY27 cash flow is not reported yet (capex is annual).

guidance.label: EBITDA margin target
guidance.statement: We have higher visibility on the 15-20% margin number in the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: we're saying that now you have higher visibility on the 15-20% margin number in the next two to three years
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: No explicit target period, so there is nothing to hold it against yet.

guidance.label: Merchant acquisition pace
guidance.statement: We expect to continue adding 25 to 30 lakhs merchants a year.
guidance.quote: we have said broadly 25 to 30 lakhs additions a year.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: Guidance for merchant, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Medium term EBITDA margin
guidance.statement: We should be able to get to those sorts of EBITDA margins of 15 to 20% in two and a half to three years from now.
guidance.quote: we will maintain about two and a half to three years from now, that we should be able to get to those sorts of EBITDA margins.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: No explicit target period, so there is nothing to hold it against yet.

guidance.label: PIDF impact offset
guidance.statement: We expect to offset at least 30-40% of the PIDF impact this quarter and more over time.
guidance.quote: Our expectation is at least 30 - 40 percent of this will be offset this quarter and more over time.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: An aspiration without a date; kept as a watch item rather than scored against an invented year.

guidance.label: Postpaid disbursal growth
guidance.statement: We expect to cross 100 crores of disbursal within six months of launch.
guidance.quote: within six months of launch, we expect to cross hundred crores of disbursal.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: Guidance for consumer credit, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: EBITDA margin outlook
guidance.statement: The EBITDA margin outlook is intact, and we are heading towards that quarter-on-quarter.
guidance.quote: the EBITDA margin outlook is intact, and we are actually heading towards that quarter-on-quarter.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: No explicit target period, so there is nothing to hold it against yet.

guidance.label: Indirect cost trend
guidance.statement: For the rest of the year, we expect indirect costs to be range bound.
guidance.quote: we expect this to be range bound.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: Not checkable against headline financials; kept as a watch item.

guidance.label: EBITDA margin target
guidance.statement: The company is driving towards an EBITDA margin of 15% to 20% over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: We do think that what we had said earlier about 15% to 20% EBITDA Margin over the next two, three years is still the number to drive towards.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: No explicit target period, so there is nothing to hold it against yet.

guidance.label: Contribution margin target
guidance.statement: The company targets contribution margins in the high 50s range.
guidance.quote: We have set high 50s, so we want to just leave some room for quarter on quarter aberrations. But we do think this is the right ballpark for us going forward.
guidance.speaker: Madhur Deora

verdict.detail: Guided on OTHER margin; the headline financials report operating (EBITDA) margin, so they are not comparable.

claims.claim: The company is committed to going all in on consumer and merchant market share.
claims.quote: I'm very happy to say this, that we are going to go all in on market share. And we call it a primary KPI for my team.

claims.claim: The company's business model is now compounding and profitable.
claims.quote: We've clearly come out of this question of whether Paytm can make profit or not. And it's very clear the business model is now compounding

claims.claim: The company is an AI-first business where every line item works with AI.
claims.quote: AI-first, the brain works. Well, the point is that all of our business runs, I can't say one line item or another, and it is every line item works with AI first.

claims.claim: The company is prioritizing high-quality GMV that contributes to the bottom line over raw GMV growth.
claims.quote: we are very clear that it is a free cash flow-generating business now. It's no more about you snap a customer or over to, because ultimately every customer is our customer.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin improved from 1% to 8% year-on-year, adjusted for PIDF.
claims.quote: Our EBITDA margin adjusted for PIDF went from 1% to 8%. So we got a 7 percentage points EBITDA margin improvement

claims.claim: Paytm is growing double the market growth of the UPI market.
claims.quote: we have talked about how we are growing double the market growth of the UPI market which effectively means we are gaining market share.

claims.claim: The company has INR 13,500 crores of cash on the books.
claims.quote: not only do we have INR 13,500 crores of cash, we are now also adding a significant amount of cash.

claims.claim: Indirect expenses are growing significantly slower than revenue growth.
claims.quote: indirect expenses are growing significantly slower than revenue growth

claims.claim: The company achieved the best quarter from a profitability standpoint on the consumer side in the last eight quarters.
claims.quote: we have had the best quarter from a profitability standpoint on the consumer side in the last eight quarters.

claims.claim: The funnel conversion on agentic workflows is 7 to 8 times higher than traditional tap workflows.
claims.quote: It's 7 or 8 times more than that, my friend. 7 or 8 times more. It is 700% better funnel because of the agentic.

claims.claim: The company has about 7% penetration in merchant lending based on the subscription merchant denominator.
claims.quote: About 7% penetration. Or obviously, there is a large number of merchant base, otherwise, beyond that.

claims.claim: More than half of the company's machines are enabled for disbursing EMIs.
claims.quote: I think the one thing I can say is more than half of our machines are enabled for disbursing EMIs.

claims.claim: Payment processing margin is consistently exceeding 4 basis points.
claims.quote: Exceeding that consistently. ... we feel pretty confident that it will stay above four basis points for the next few quarters.

claims.claim: Paytm's merchant base is superior in quality compared to peers.
claims.quote: it's very clear from other people's disclosure that our merchant base is actually a superior merchant base in terms of quality.

claims.claim: Sales employee cost is at an all-time high this quarter.
claims.quote: you would see that our sales employee cost this quarter is actually all time high.

claims.claim: Payment processing margin improvement is sustainable.
claims.quote: As an overall trend, we think this is sustainable.

claims.claim: Paytm is gaining market share in travel.
claims.quote: We are seeing market share growth there.

claims.claim: The simplification journey of the Paytm app is more or less done.
claims.quote: I believe that the simplification journey is more or less done.

claims.claim: Paytm expects subscription revenues to be toppled by MDR revenues.
claims.quote: We do foresee that, that month is not very far when our subscription revenues get toppled by our MDR revenues.

claims.claim: The company achieved a 60% contribution margin in Q1 FY26.
claims.quote: I think one by one on contribution margin, we are at 60%, as you noted.

claims.claim: The company successfully increased prices for its POS products without seeing merchant churn.
claims.quote: I personally want to tell you internally we did increase the price and it worked out and sort of it's a funny thing.

claims.claim: Paytm's market share in POS machines has increased over the last 12 to 18 months.
claims.quote: We increased that. So, yes, safe to assume that it did not decline.

claims.claim: The company is moving away from reporting adjusted metrics like EBITDA before ESOP.
claims.quote: Next quarter onward, we will stop giving the ESOP line, and it will be only the employee cost.
